_source.method: Nearest airport with an IATA code and scheduled service, discounting the straight-line distance by 60km for a large hub and 25km for a medium one, capped at 250km. Straight-line from the city coordinate, so road distance can be longer. Cities with nothing in range are omitted rather than guessed at. Twenty large cities carry a searchCode, the IATA metropolitan area code, because the nearest airport there is the domestic one: searching NYC covers JFK, Newark and LaGuardia together.
